ctx.x: And, of course, we had -- Claude had left the band. Claude Jones had left the band and we got Gene Simon in the trombone section so we still had three trombones. And the same trumpet section, Sidney DeParis, Manzie Langston Curl, and Shirley Clay. And Manzie Johnson and --
